Key Aide Arrested in Veeramani POCSO Case, Funds Traced

Police have arrested Ganesan, a former aide of mining baron R. Veeramani, in connection with the Veeramani POCSO case. Ganesan, who worked at Gem Granites for 23 years, is accused of helping Veeramani avoid police action. Investigators have traced funds to a railway union leader. The case has also led to a political confrontation between the ruling TVK and the DMK.
